built_from: working tree before the round 16 commit (development build, not a release build)
pdf_groups_detail: PDF listed in the confirmed scope; admin only; pages 1 and 2 drawn by the isolated renderer with exact pixels; read proof names page, pixels and renderer; missing pages refused; original unchanged

selection uses the page as drawn; forged browser pixels ignored; unselected area black; a proof for one page does not cover another; images never take a page; delivery equals preview; other account and wrong password refused; requester sees no source metadata

encrypted (user and owner-only), unreadable, empty, 201-page, oversized-page, and decompression-bomb documents are refused with no read proof; a document at the 5 MiB storage ceiling and one at the 200-page limit still work; later reads are unaffected

replaced bytes and expense edits block the delivery and purge its PNG; a replaced source needs a new read and selection; revoked and expired deliveries answer 410 and their PNG is removed; a removed source cannot be read
in the API container the renderer cannot open a file, open a socket, start a program or a process, or exceed its memory and CPU ceilings, and still renders; no renderer process outlives its request
simultaneous PDF pages answer 200 or 429 only and recover immediately
revoking the remaining deliveries removes every temporary PNG of this request
